suggestedOps.title: Opérations suggérées
suggestedOps.description: L’IA a suggéré ceci. Rien ne s’exécute tant que vous ne l’avez pas approuvé.
suggestedOps.empty: Rien ne vous attend pour le moment.
suggestedOps.loadFailed: Cmdr n’a pas pu lire les suggestions. Fermez cette fenêtre et rouvrez-la.
suggestedOps.agentReasonTooltip: The AI’s own words. Cmdr didn’t check them.
suggestedOps.approve.trash: Move {countText} {count, plural, one {file} other {files}} to Trash
suggestedOps.reversible.trash: You can undo this: {count, plural, one {it goes} other {they go}} to the Trash
suggestedOps.reversible.moveBack: You can undo this: Cmdr can move {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} back
suggestedOps.reversible.renameBack: You can undo this: Cmdr can change the {count, plural, one {name} other {names}} back
suggestedOps.reversible.removeCopies: You can undo this: Cmdr deletes the copies
suggestedOps.reversible.removeArchive: You can undo this: Cmdr deletes the new archive
suggestedOps.reversible.removeExtracted: You can undo this: Cmdr deletes what it extracted
suggestedOps.irreversible.delete: This can’t be undone: the files are deleted for good
suggestedOps.blocked.noTrash: Can’t run: this drive has no Trash
suggestedOps.blocked.noTrashTooltip: The drive these files are on keeps no Trash, so moving them there can’t work and nothing would happen. Reject this, or delete the files yourself if that’s what you want.
suggestedOps.irreversible.overwrite: This can’t be undone: it replaces an existing archive
suggestedOps.folderWillBeCreatedTooltip: Le dossier de destination n’existe pas encore. En approuvant, Cmdr le crée, exactement comme si vous lanciez le déplacement vous-même.
suggestedOps.destinationUnknown: Cmdr n’a pas pu vérifier le dossier de destination
suggestedOps.destinationNotConnectedTool: Cmdr hasn’t connected to this drive or server yet. Approving won’t start until it’s connected, the same as when you move files there yourself.
suggestedOps.changedUnderReview: L’IA a modifié cette suggestion pendant votre lecture.
suggestedOps.snapshotOnly: From when the AI suggested this
suggestedOps.snapshotOnlyTooltip: Cmdr couldn’t check this file just now, so this is what it was when the AI suggested it.
suggestedOps.sourceNotConnected: Cmdr isn’t connected to the drive these files are on, so their sizes and dates are from when the AI suggested this.
suggestedOps.sourceGone: The drive these files were on isn’t here any more, so their sizes and dates are from when the AI suggested this.
suggestedOps.filesLoadFailed: Cmdr n’a pas pu charger ces fichiers.
suggestedOps.decisionNotRecorded: Cmdr n’a pas pu enregistrer votre réponse. Réessayez.
suggestedOps.approvalUnsure: Cmdr ne sait pas si l’approbation a abouti. Vérifiez la file d’attente des opérations avant de l’approuver à nouveau.
suggestedOps.refusal.label: Pourquoi rien n’a démarré
suggestedOps.refusal.nothingToRun.messag: Cmdr n’a pu lire aucun de ces fichiers au moment de votre approbation, il n’a donc rien lancé.
suggestedOps.refusal.nothingToRun.sugges: Vérifiez qu’ils sont toujours là, puis approuvez à nouveau cette suggestion ou refusez-la.
suggestedOps.refusal.nothingSelected.mes: None of the files you ticked are in this suggestion any more, so nothing ran.
suggestedOps.refusal.nothingSelected.sug: Tick the files you want, then approve it again.
suggestedOps.refusal.couldNotStart.messa: Cmdr n’a pas pu transformer cette suggestion en opération, il n’a donc rien lancé.
suggestedOps.refusal.couldNotStart.sugge: Refusez-la, puis demandez à l’IA de la suggérer à nouveau.
suggestedOps.indicatorTooltip: Des suggestions de l’IA vous attendent. Cliquez pour les examiner.
